rationale: No matching standard SNOMED concept for a general "non-paroxysmal, subtype not further specified" category. SNOMED only offers the specific subtypes (persistent/long-standing persistent/permanent).
No standard SNOMED concept for AF specifically detected via implanted device monitoring, as distinct from clinically diagnosed AF.
Parent concept for AF pattern classification, per AFBSTEP baseline codebook variable mh_hr_afib_pattern.

concept_name: Heart failure with mildly reduced ejection fraction (HFmrEF)
rationale: No matching standard SNOMED concept for HFmrEF (LVEF 40-49%), a category introduced in the 2016 ESC heart failure guidelines. Source: AFBSTEP baseline codebook, variable mh_hf_pheno, value 2.

concept_name: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF)
rationale: No standard SNOMED condition concept found using the exact term "HFpEF" or "preserved ejection fraction". A related but not fully equivalent standard concept exists: concept_id 443587 "Diastolic heart failure" - not used as the primary mapping since HFpEF and diastolic heart failure are not strictly synonymous. Source: AFBSTEP baseline codebook, variable mh_hf_pheno, value 3.
No matching standard SNOMED concept for recovered/improved ejection fraction heart failure category. Source: AFBSTEP baseline codebook, variable mh_hf_pheno, value 4.
Parent concept for heart failure phenotype classification by LVEF per ESC guidelines, per AFBSTEP baseline codebook variable mh_hf_pheno.
Not yet present as a standard concept in SNOMED/LOINC. Sex-agnostic CHA2DS2-VA variant introduced in ESC 2024 AF guideline; source: AFBSTEP baseline codebook, variable scores_chadsva.
Catch-all for atrial fibrillation ablation procedures not classified as PVI. Source: treatment_cat, value 3.
No standard SNOMED procedure concept found specifically for CTI/typical atrial flutter ablation. Source: treatment_cat, value 4.
No standard SNOMED procedure concept found for atrial tachycardia ablation specifically. Source: treatment_cat, value 5.
No standard SNOMED procedure concept found for general SVT ablation. Source: treatment_cat, value 6.
No standard SNOMED procedure concept found for PVC ablation. Source: treatment_cat, value 8.
Catch-all category for treatments not covered by other treatment_cat values. Source: treatment_cat, value 14.
No standard SNOMED procedure concept covering both implantation and revision as one combined category.
Catch-all category for coronary revascularisation procedures (PCI or CABG) as a single baseline/history variable.

No standard SNOMED device concept for the general fact "any CIED present" as a device category, as distinct from specific device types (pacemaker, ICD, CRT). Source: AFBSTEP baseline codebook, variable mh_dev.

No standalone SNOMED device concept for "radiofrequency" as an energy source category independent of a specific procedure. Source: AFBSTEP followup_treatment codebook, variable energy_modality, value 1.
No standalone SNOMED device concept for "cryoballoon" as an energy source category. Source: AFBSTEP followup_treatment codebook, variable energy_modality, value 2.
No standalone SNOMED device concept for "laser" as an ablation energy source category. Source: AFBSTEP followup_treatment codebook, variable energy_modality, value 4.
Catch-all category for ablation energy sources not otherwise specified. Source: AFBSTEP followup_treatment codebook, variable energy_modality, value 5.

concept_name: Other/Unspecified ablation energy source for pulmonary vein to left atrium conduction system
rationale: No standalone SNOMED device concept for an unspecified PVI energy source at the pulmonary-vein-to-left-atrium conduction site.

No standard SNOMED/LOINC device concept for consumer wearable PPG devices (smartwatches, smart rings) as a device category, as distinct from the photoplethysmography technique itself (4216243). Source: AFBSTEP afburden/afepisodes codebook, variable assessmentmodality/afepisode_modality, value 5.

No standalone SNOMED device concept for "pulsed-field"/irreversible electroporation as an energy source category independent of a specific catheter system. Available SNOMED concepts (e.g. 604668, 45764827) describe physical device systems, not the energy modality itself — inconsistent with the sibling concepts for radiofrequency and cryoballoon energy sources, which are abstract energy categories. Source: AFBSTEP followup_treatment codebook, variable energy_modality, value 3.
No standard SNOMED concept for a generic, unspecified peri-procedural complication flag. Source: AFBSTEP followup_treatment codebook, variable procedure_complication.
Not a specific clinical diagnosis but a study endpoint category ("hospitalization for any reason"). Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable event_cat, value 13.
No standard SNOMED concept for a general, unspecified "major bleeding" endpoint per ISTH criteria. Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable event_cat, value 20.

concept_name: Clinically relevant non-major bleeding (CRNM, ISTH criteria)
rationale: No standard SNOMED concept for CRNM bleeding, a specific ISTH classification used in anticoagulation trials. Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable event_cat, value 21.

concept_name: Decline in eGFR of 50% or more from baseline
rationale: No standard SNOMED/LOINC concept for a relative percentage decline in eGFR as an endpoint category. Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable event_cat, value 30.
No standard SNOMED concept distinguishing "recurrent" atrial fibrillation as a temporal/study-endpoint category. Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable event_cat, value 41.
No standard SNOMED concept distinguishing "recurrent" atrial tachycardia. Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable event_cat, value 42.

No standard SNOMED concept distinguishing "new-onset" atrial fibrillation as a temporal/study-endpoint category, as opposed to the general diagnosis (concept_id 313217). Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable event_cat, value 40.
No standard SNOMED concept for AF progression (e.g. paroxysmal to persistent) as a study-endpoint category.
No standard SNOMED concept for systemic (non-cerebral) embolism as a general study-endpoint category.
No standard SNOMED concept for hospitalization specifically attributed to heart failure as a study-endpoint category, as distinct from hospitalization for any cause (2000005001).
No standard SNOMED concept for the general study-endpoint category "non-cardiovascular cause of death". Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable death_cause, value 0.

concept_name: Death due to cardiovascular cause, unspecified
rationale: No standard SNOMED concept for the general study-endpoint category "cardiovascular cause of death, unspecified". Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable death_cause, value 1.

No matching standard SNOMED concept for a general "stroke as cause of death" category, subtype unspecified. Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable death_cause, value 5. Where a partner's source data specifies the stroke subtype, a more precise standard concept should be used instead (see the general note on searching Athena for finer-grained cause of death concepts).
No standard SNOMED/clinical concept exists for a study-administrative reason for follow-up ending. Source: AFBSTEP followup codebook, variable censor_reason, value 1.

concept_name: Last sign of life confirmed via automated remote CIED device transmission
rationale: No standard SNOMED concept found for confirmation of patient status via automatic remote cardiac device monitoring/transmission. Source: AFBSTEP followup codebook, variable last_contact_setting, value 5.
Generic parent concept for "how was the last contact/ascertainment for this outcome event obtained". Source: AFBSTEP followup_outcomes codebook, variable source.
Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable adherence (Zeemering definition).

concept_name: Time since first atrial fibrillation diagnosis
rationale: No matching standard SNOMED/LOINC concept for a study-specific derived time interval "days since first AF diagnosis, relative to inclusion". Source: AFBSTEP baseline codebook.

concept_name: Duration of longest atrial fibrillation/SCAF episode before inclusion
rationale: No matching standard SNOMED concept for AF-specific longest-episode duration. Source: AFBSTEP baseline codebook, variable mh_hr_afib_longest_ep.

concept_name: Atrial fibrillation burden, percent time in AF
rationale: No standard LOINC/SNOMED concept found for "AF burden" as a continuous percentage measure. This is a relatively recent, research-driven metric not yet represented in standard vocabularies. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable afburden_value.
Parent concept linking to the specific estimation method used for AF burden calculation. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable afburden_method.

concept_name: AF burden method: percent time, continuous CIED monitoring
rationale: No standard concept names the method used to estimate AF burden; the parent question concept (2000008003) is itself custom, so its answers can have no standard equivalents. AF burden measured as the percent of monitored time spent in AF, from continuous CIED monitoring. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable afburden_method, value 1.

concept_name: AF burden method: percent ECGs, intermittent monitoring
rationale: No standard concept names the method used to estimate AF burden; the parent question concept (2000008003) is itself custom, so its answers can have no standard equivalents. AF burden estimated as the proportion of intermittently recorded ECGs classified as AF. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable afburden_method, value 2.

concept_name: AF burden method: derived from days in sinus rhythm
rationale: No standard concept names the method used to estimate AF burden; the parent question concept (2000008003) is itself custom, so its answers can have no standard equivalents. AF burden derived from the recorded number of days in sinus rhythm rather than measured directly. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable afburden_method, value 3.

concept_name: Fraction of days in sinus rhythm
rationale: Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable sr_fraction (EAST-AFNET 4 sensitivity definition).

concept_name: Number of analysable ECGs in monitoring period
rationale: Denominator for intermittent AF-burden estimation. Source: variable n_ecg_total.

concept_name: Number of ECGs classified as AF in monitoring period
rationale: Numerator for intermittent AF-burden estimation. Source: variable n_ecg_af.

No standard concept asks how a burden assessment was carried out as a question with a controlled answer set; the modes AFBSTEP distinguishes are project-specific. Parent question concept for the mode of assessment, answered by 2000009034, 2000009001 and 2000009002. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable assessmentmode.

No standard concept names this monitoring mode as an answer to how AF burden was assessed; the parent question concept (2000009000) is itself custom, so its answers can have no standard equivalents. Monitoring performed as repeated discrete recordings rather than continuously, leaving gaps between them. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable assessmentmode, value 2.

No standard concept names this monitoring mode as an answer to how AF burden was assessed; the parent question concept (2000009000) is itself custom, so its answers can have no standard equivalents. Burden derived from a single assessment rather than from repeated or continuous monitoring. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable assessmentmode, value 3.
Parent concept for episode duration observation. Source: AFBSTEP afepisodes codebook, variable afepisode_duration.

concept_name: Maximum atrial/ventricular rate during arrhythmia episode
rationale: No standard LOINC/SNOMED concept for peak heart rate during a specific arrhythmia episode. Source: AFBSTEP afepisodes codebook, variable afepisode_maxrate.
Parent concept linking to whether the episode was symptomatic (value_as_concept_id = 4142947 Symptomatic, SNOMED qualifier). Source: AFBSTEP afepisodes codebook, variable afepisode_symptomatic.
No standard concept for the Atrial Fibrillation Effect on QualiTy-of-life (AFEQT) total score, a validated AF-specific patient-reported outcome measure.

concept_name: Atrial fibrillation modified EHRA symptom class (mEHRA)
rationale: No standard concept for the modified EHRA symptom classification specific to atrial fibrillation.

No standard vocabulary encodes the modified EHRA scale, so its classes have no standard answer concepts; the parent question concept (2000009007) is itself custom. Modified EHRA symptom class I: no symptoms attributable to atrial fibrillation. Answer concept for 2000009007.

concept_name: mEHRA class IIa: mild symptoms; normal daily activity not affected
rationale: No standard vocabulary encodes the modified EHRA scale, so its classes have no standard answer concepts; the parent question concept (2000009007) is itself custom. Modified EHRA symptom class IIa: mild symptoms, normal daily activity not affected by AF-related symptoms. Answer concept for 2000009007.

concept_name: mEHRA class IIb: moderate symptoms; normal daily activity not affected but patient troubled by symptoms
rationale: No standard vocabulary encodes the modified EHRA scale, so its classes have no standard answer concepts; the parent question concept (2000009007) is itself custom. Modified EHRA symptom class IIb: moderate symptoms, normal daily activity not affected, but patient troubled by symptoms. Answer concept for 2000009007.

concept_name: mEHRA class III: severe symptoms; normal daily activity affected
rationale: No standard vocabulary encodes the modified EHRA scale, so its classes have no standard answer concepts; the parent question concept (2000009007) is itself custom. Modified EHRA symptom class III: severe symptoms, normal daily activity affected by AF-related symptoms. Answer concept for 2000009007.

concept_name: mEHRA class IV: disabling symptoms; normal daily activity discontinued
rationale: No standard vocabulary encodes the modified EHRA scale, so its classes have no standard answer concepts; the parent question concept (2000009007) is itself custom. Modified EHRA symptom class IV: disabling symptoms, normal daily activity discontinued. Answer concept for 2000009007.

concept_name: Longest atrial fibrillation episode duration during monitoring window
rationale: No standard concept for the longest single AF episode duration within an aggregated monitoring window. Derived from device-reported episode-level data (e.g. Abbott Merlin.net, Medtronic CareLink remote monitoring exports).

concept_name: Shortest atrial fibrillation episode duration during monitoring window
rationale: No standard concept for the shortest single AF episode duration within an aggregated monitoring window.

concept_name: Average atrial fibrillation episode duration during monitoring window
rationale: No standard concept for the mean AF episode duration across all episodes within an aggregated monitoring window.

concept_name: Standard deviation of atrial fibrillation episode duration during monitoring window
rationale: No standard concept for the dispersion of AF episode durations within an aggregated monitoring window.

concept_name: Average heart rate during atrial fibrillation
rationale: No standard concept for mean ventricular rate during AF over a monitoring window, as distinct from the peak rate already pinned (2000009004, maximum rate during a single episode).

concept_name: Standard deviation of average heart rate during atrial fibrillation
rationale: No standard concept for the dispersion of the mean ventricular rate during AF within a monitoring window.

concept_name: Number of beats per atrial fibrillation episode
rationale: No standard concept for the total beat count within a single AF episode, as distinct from a rate measure. Describes one disaggregated episode, not a window aggregate.

concept_name: Number of atrial fibrillation episodes during monitoring window
rationale: No standard concept for a count of discrete AF episodes within an aggregated monitoring window, as distinct from the burden percentage (2000008002).

concept_name: Absolute time in atrial fibrillation during monitoring window
rationale: No standard concept for the absolute duration of AF within a window, as distinct from the burden percentage (2000008002). Some device exports report both.

concept_name: Date of first atrial fibrillation detection within monitoring window
rationale: No standard concept for the first AF detection timestamp within a monitoring window, relevant for time-to-event analyses.
No standard concept for the percentage of atrial beats that were paced, as reported by CIED remote monitoring.
No standard concept for the percentage of ventricular beats that were paced.
No standard concept for the count of device-delivered shocks for atrial tachyarrhythmia/AF.
No standard concept for the count of device-delivered shocks for ventricular tachycardia/fibrillation.
No standard concept for accelerometer-derived daily activity duration reported by a CIED, as distinct from patient-reported activity surveys (e.g. 46235546, PASII).
No standard concept for the count of device-detected fluid status threshold crossings, used as an indirect heart failure decompensation marker.

concept_name: Spontaneous non-sustained tachycardia episode count per day
rationale: No standard concept for a daily count of spontaneous non-sustained tachycardia episodes as reported by CIED remote monitoring.

concept_name: Premature ventricular complex burden, percent of beats
rationale: No standard concept for PVC burden as a percentage of total beats, analogous to the AF burden percentage (2000008002).

No standard concept for a device-measured daily thoracic impedance value. Electrical resistance across the chest, measured via the lead — falls when fluid accumulates in the lungs, an early sign of worsening heart failure before symptoms appear.

No standard concept for the cumulative deviation of daily impedance from the patient's own reference baseline (2000009033) over time. A rising trend, not a single low day, is what triggers the device's fluid-status alert.
No standard concept for the patient-specific "normal" impedance value the device establishes over time and compares daily measurements against.

No standard concept names this monitoring mode as an answer to how AF burden was assessed; the parent question concept (2000009000) is itself custom, so its answers can have no standard equivalents. Monitoring performed continuously, with no gaps between recordings. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook, variable assessmentmode, value 1.
No standard concept for diurnal/daytime-specific resting heart rate as a distinct device-reported metric.
No standard concept for nocturnal/nighttime-specific resting heart rate as a distinct device-reported metric.

concept_name: Maximum heart rate during AF within window
rationale: No standard concept for peak ventricular rate during AF over a monitoring window, as distinct from the mean rate (2000009017) and the single-episode peak rate (2000009004).

No standard concept identifies an externally stored document as a source file type. The Note Type vocabulary comes closest, but its concepts are non-standard and are not loaded in the project's Athena export. The custom External Data domain exists because no standard domain covers references to content held outside the CDM. File type marker for source.file_concept_id, referencing a PDF or scanned document stored externally. Source: AFBSTEP data linkage for PDF/audio files stored externally.

No standard concept identifies an externally stored audio recording as a source file type; the custom External Data domain exists because no standard domain covers references to content held outside the CDM. File type marker for source.file_concept_id, referencing an audio file stored externally, as distinct from a PDF or scanned document (2000010000).

No standard concept identifies a device-generated AF-burden report as a source file type; the custom External Data domain exists because no standard domain covers references to content held outside the CDM. File type marker for source.file_concept_id, referencing raw device-generated AF-burden reports stored externally.

No standard concept identifies a raw ECG waveform recording as a source file type; the custom External Data domain exists because no standard domain covers references to content held outside the CDM. File type marker for source.file_concept_id, referencing raw ECG/Holter waveform files (e.g. SCP-ECG, EDF) stored externally.

No standard concept identifies a CIED remote-monitoring transmission export as a source file type; the custom External Data domain exists because no standard domain covers references to content held outside the CDM. File type marker for source.file_concept_id, referencing continuous CIED remote patient monitoring transmission data stored externally.

No standard concept identifies an in-clinic CIED interrogation report as a source file type; the custom External Data domain exists because no standard domain covers references to content held outside the CDM. File type marker for source.file_concept_id, referencing scheduled in-clinic CIED interrogation reports (PDF), distinct from continuous remote monitoring data (2000010004).

No standard episode concept distinguishes an aggregated burden window from a single arrhythmia episode. The Case A / Case B split is an AFBSTEP modelling decision about how monitoring data is structured, so no standard vocabulary could express it. Marks an episode row as an aggregated continuous AF-burden window (Case A), linked to measurement/observation rows via episode_event. Source: AFBSTEP afburden codebook.

No standard episode concept distinguishes a single arrhythmia episode from an aggregated burden window. The Case A / Case B split is an AFBSTEP modelling decision about how monitoring data is structured, so no standard vocabulary could express it. Marks an episode row as a single disaggregated arrhythmia episode (Case B), linked to measurement/observation rows via episode_event. Source: AFBSTEP afepisodes codebook.
Ingredient-class concept for vitamin K antagonists (e.g. warfarin, phenprocoumon) where a source records drug class rather than the specific agent.

No standard concept found for a generic marker meaning "the value is missing and the reason is not known to the source system" - distinct from Test not performed (45884199, cause known: not attempted) and Unable to determine (45880382, cause known: attempted but uninterpretable). Used when a partner's source data has a null/missing marker without further qualification.

No standard concept classifies the design of a contributing study; this is study metadata rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Randomised controlled trial: participants are allocated to arms by randomisation. Source: provider questionnaire A5, study type RCT.

No standard concept classifies the design of a contributing study; this is study metadata rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Interventional study run under an investigational device exemption, where the device under study is not yet approved for the indication. Source: provider questionnaire A5, study type Interventional IDE.

No standard concept classifies the design of a contributing study; this is study metadata rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Observational cohort: participants are followed over time with no intervention assigned by the study. Source: provider questionnaire A5, study type Observational cohort.

No standard concept classifies the design of a contributing study; this is study metadata rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Remote patient monitoring programme or disease registry: data is collected as part of routine care or surveillance rather than a protocol-driven study. Source: provider questionnaire A5, study type RPM / registry.

No standard concept classifies the design of a contributing study; this is study metadata rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Administrative claims or reimbursement data, contributed as a data source rather than as a study. Source: provider questionnaire A5, study type Claims data.

No standard concept classifies the design of a contributing study; this is study metadata rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Catch-all for a study design none of the other A5 values covers; the provider's free-text study_name carries the detail. Source: provider questionnaire A5, study type Other.

No standard concept records the delivery status of a contributed dataset; this is an administrative property of a data transfer rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. A locked dataset is final and will not be updated further. Source: provider questionnaire A10.

No standard concept records the delivery status of a contributed dataset; this is an administrative property of a data transfer rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. A rolling dataset is updated periodically, so later transfers may revise or extend earlier ones. Source: provider questionnaire A10.

No standard concept records how often a partner transfers data; this is an operational property of the contribution rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Data is transferred once, as a single delivery, with no further transfers expected. Source: provider questionnaire A11, transfer frequency one-off.

No standard concept records how often a partner transfers data; this is an operational property of the contribution rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Data is transferred repeatedly on a recurring schedule, so each delivery may revise or extend the last. Source: provider questionnaire A11, transfer frequency periodic.

No standard concept records how much data a partner provides; this is a governance property of the contribution rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Only study-level metadata is provided; no participant-level records at all. Source: provider questionnaire A12, provision level metadata only.

No standard concept records how much data a partner provides; this is a governance property of the contribution rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Participant-level tabular analysis data, without raw signal or imaging files. Source: provider questionnaire A12, provision level tabular analysis data.

concept_name: Tabular analysis data incl. raw signals
rationale: No standard concept records how much data a partner provides; this is a governance property of the contribution rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Participant-level tabular analysis data together with the underlying raw signal recordings, referenced from the source table. Source: provider questionnaire A12, provision level tabular analysis data incl. raw signals.

concept_name: Tabular analysis data incl. raw imaging
rationale: No standard concept records how much data a partner provides; this is a governance property of the contribution rather than a clinical fact, and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Participant-level tabular analysis data together with the underlying raw imaging, referenced from the source table. Source: provider questionnaire A12, provision level tabular analysis data incl. raw imaging.

No standard concept names the attribute a study_attribute row describes; the row-typing scheme is specific to AFBSTEP's own extension table and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Marks a study_attribute row as recording the study's data provision level, answered by 2000013011 to 2000013014. Source: provider questionnaire A12.

No standard concept names the attribute a study_attribute row describes; the row-typing scheme is specific to AFBSTEP's own extension table and belongs to the custom Methodological Concept domain. Marks a study_attribute row as recording a country of data collection, answered by standard OMOP geography concepts rather than custom ones. Source: provider questionnaire A8.

No standard concept marks a visit_occurrence row as the protocol's baseline visit. Recorded as an observation row (observation_concept_id = this concept, observation_event_id = the visit_occurrence_id, obs_event_field_concept_id set accordingly) so analysis tables can reconstruct which visit anchors baseline ascertainment. At most one such row per person.

No standard concept for a non-binary/third gender category exists in the Gender vocabulary/domain (only FEMALE 8507/MALE 8532 exist as standard concepts). Legally recognized third gender category in Germany since 2018 ("divers").
